note: Quicklink stores all state in one config object, quicklink.settings (route quicklink.settings at admin/config/development/performance/quicklink, permission 'administer site configuration'). No plugins, Drush, or permissions. Medium cases write a known value into quicklink.settings and the agent reads it back with drush cget; hard cases reset a key to a known baseline and the agent must set it, verified with drush cget against quicklink.settings. All scripts touch only quicklink.settings keys.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site using the Quicklink module, what is the machine name of the configuration object that holds all of Quicklink's settings, and at what admin path is its settings form?
evals.expected_output: All settings live in the config object quicklink.settings, edited at admin/config/development/performance/quicklink (route quicklink.settings, permission 'administer site configuration').

evals.prompt: In the Quicklink module, which setting makes the prefetch library load for anonymous users only (i.e. not for logged-in users)? Give the config key.
evals.expected_output: The boolean key no_load_when_authenticated in quicklink.settings ('Prefetch for anonymous users only'); when TRUE the Quicklink library is not attached for authenticated users.

evals.prompt: With the Quicklink module, how do I stop certain links from being prefetched - for example ignoring admin paths and any URL that contains '/checkout'? Name the relevant settings.
evals.expected_output: Enable ignore_admin_paths (skips /admin and /edit) and add '/checkout' to the newline-separated url_patterns_to_ignore list; ignore_selectors can skip links matching a CSS selector. All are keys of quicklink.settings.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has Quicklink installed and configured. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the exact URL pattern that has been added to Quicklink's 'URL patterns to ignore' list.
evals.expected_output: quicklink.settings.url_patterns_to_ignore is set to 'qlk_secret_path' (read with: drush cget quicklink.settings url_patterns_to_ignore).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Quicklink's throttle options have been changed from their defaults. Inspect the live Quicklink configuration and tell me the configured total request limit.
evals.expected_output: quicklink.settings.total_request_limit is 42 (read with: drush cget quicklink.settings total_request_limit). The shipped default is 0.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Quicklink so that the prefetch library loads for anonymous users only, and so that it never prefetches any link whose URL contains 'qlk_block_me'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set quicklink.settings.no_load_when_authenticated to TRUE and add 'qlk_block_me' to url_patterns_to_ignore (e.g. via drush php:eval configFactory getEditable set save, or the settings form).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, turn on Quicklink's debug mode and scope prefetching to only the '.main-content' region by overriding Quicklink's parent selector. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set quicklink.settings.enable_debug_mode to TRUE and selector to '.main-content'.
